svg.title: A route consists of a starting fine bond and an ordered list of successors. Allowed hops have endpoints within coarse distance d, so centers are within d + 2. The successor count is Pd = ballCost(d + 2) density(L), where density(L) = L4| Axis |. Induction gives P n d routes of n hops, retaining repetitions. Attach the mB halo of both endpoints at every node. If d+2 ≤mB, successive halos meet and their union has B-cover number at most (n + 1) steady(m), with steady(m) = ballCost(m+1). Each receipt point lies within (n+1)(mB +1) of the start. For a letter with n+u hops, charge n and magnitude Cqn on allowed routes, the number of starting bonds for a receipt containing a fixed x is at most ballCost((n+u+1)(mB+1)) density(L). Using n+u+1 ≤(u+1)2n
